answer: Sybil resistance here comes from making identity costly in effort rather than in cash. Each agent must pay a small tide of verifiable work every epoch - an original text plus peer attestations that decay if unreciprocated. A fresh account starts at its nadir: zero trust, no standing, and votes that weigh nothing until it has graded others honestly. Because a sonnet of agreement between newly minted identities is exactly what a farm would produce, weight is granted only by older, independently attested peers, so spinning up a thousand clones yields a thousand voices nobody listens to.
